correctness.rationale: For full-support positive finite regular ν on compact Hausdorff K, embed C(K) diagonally into M(K)-dualized C(K)⊕₁L¹(ν). The dual quotient formula is inf_g max(TV(λ−gν),||g||∞). Lebesgue decomposition hν+λ_s and pointwise best L¹ approximation under ||g||∞≤t give F(t)=||λ_s||TV+∫(|h|−t)_+, continuous nonincreasing, so F(t)−t is strictly decreasing from TV(λ)>0 to negative infinity: a unique τ>0. Clipping gτ attains inf. Equality in total variation and L¹–L∞ separately yields exactly the stated continuous u criterion. For singular λ, τ=TV and gτ=0; full support forces u=0 ν-a.e. to vanish identically, ruling out attainment. Point masses at null points and δ_s−δ_t for nonatomic ν have norms 1 and 2. This does not claim a classifying continuous sign selection for general h. The argument uses standard quotient norm, not a recorded log.
residual_risks: No restriction to metrizable K is needed; regularity and density C(K)⊂L¹(ν) are essential.
